attributes.board_name: Kentucky Board of Licensure for Occupational Therapy

rules.accepted_credit_types: CE courses incl. workshops, conferences, electronic and self-study (1 CCU per contact hour); employer in-service (max 6); academic courses (6 CCUs per credit hour); independent study (max 6); mentorship (1 CCU per 5 h); fieldwork supervision (1 CCU per 40 h per student); writing (book 12, editing 6, chapter 6, peer-reviewed article 4, other article 2); presentations; advanced/specialty certification (up to 12 each, category max 6) and other activities listed in Section 3.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Licensed less than 12 months: prorate 1 CCU per month licensed. Licensed fewer than 90 days before the renewal date: no renewal in the first year.
rules.audit_note: Random audit of up to 10% of licensees; respond within 60 days. Keep documentation at least 1 year after the end of the renewal period; do not send it unless audited.

topics.who: Board-pre-approved training in suicide assessment, treatment and management (KRS 210.366), at least once every 6 years from initial licensure or the last training

rules.notes: 1 CCU = 1 contact hour of 60 minutes (excluding meals, breaks, registration), so 12 CCUs = 12 hours per annual renewal period. Annual renewal due on or before October 31 (201 KAR 28:060E, emergency amendment July 2026), with a 60-day grace period and $25 late fee.
